speed_tuning_bootstrap.name: properties
speed_tuning_bootstrap.documentation: Response units and response type (e.g. mean, F1) of the input tuning curve.

speed_tuning_bootstrap.name: significance
speed_tuning_bootstrap.documentation: Visual-response ANOVA p-values of the input tuning curve (visual_response_anova_p, across_stimuli_anova_p), as in speed_tuning.

speed_tuning_bootstrap.name: point_estimate
speed_tuning_bootstrap.documentation: The free Priebe fit to the observed condition means: Priebe_fit_parameters [A zeta xi sigma_sf sigma_tf sf0 tf0], the speed tuning index xi, SF and TF preferences, sse and r_squared.

speed_tuning_bootstrap.name: bootstrap
speed_tuning_bootstrap.documentation: Description of the stored bootstrap fits (attached file speed_tuning_bootstrap_fits.ngrid, numBootstrap x 9 doubles): numBootstrap, numValid (successful fits), column names, median trials per condition, and the stimulus SF and TF ranges.

speed_tuning_bootstrap.name: indexes
speed_tuning_bootstrap.documentation: Indexes computed from the bootstrap fits by vis.speed.bootstrap.indexes: xi (estimate, intervals, p-values), inseparable and speedTuned classifications (0/1, one value per threshold), tfShiftOctaves, speedChangeOctaves, passbandOctaves, preferredSpeed, quality flags, and the thresholds used (parameters).
